newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS trading passes three million mark.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS trading passes three million mark.

text.p: Trading on New York Mercantile Exchange's ACCESS after-hours electronic system passed the three million lot mark Tuesday night when 7,928 contracts changed hands, a NYMEX official said.
Volume since ACCESS began June 24, 1993, reached 3,001,113 lots.
Daily trading volume has grown steadily to an average of 5,000 contracts each night, the exchange said.
Crude oil futures are the most actively traded, with an average of 2,200 lots a night done.
"We are very pleased with this record which reflects the 20 percent year-to-date increase in volume on the system," NYMEX president Patrick Thompson said.

"We are especially pleased with the increase in trading we have seen by Asia Pacific participants since our link with the Sydney Futures Exchange SYCOM system and look forward to further expansion in this area when terminals open in Hong Kong during the first quarter of next year," he said.
